free_tier.stated: Hobby plan, USD 0 a month, as listed on the pricing page: 2,000 requests a day at 100 requests a minute, Essentials data, standard IP lookup only (no self lookup, no batch), no credit card. The home page now links to Contact Us in place of a sign-up page, and the sign-up host answers HTTP 522.
free_tier.notes: The daily quota counts every endpoint together; past it the API answers HTTP 429 DailyLimitExceeded until the reset time, and past the per-minute rate HTTP 429 RateLimitExceeded. The API servers are in the US and Asia. Starter is USD 25 a month for 50,000 requests a day at 800 a minute.

per_object_cap.stated: one IP address per lookup on Hobby; the batch lookup takes up to 25 addresses a request and starts at the Growth plan

interface_detail: GET /ip/{ip-address}?api-key=KEY, GET /ip/me (self lookup) and POST /ip/batch (a JSON array) on an API-server host named {api-server}.geolocated.io, JSON over HTTPS; the key is tied to the chosen API server
chaining: Not reachable for a new account: the sign-up page is no longer linked and its host answers HTTP 522, so the 2,000 daily lookups of Hobby cannot be obtained. Bulk path: none on Hobby; the batch lookup (25 addresses a request) is on Growth and Scale

limits.value: 2,000 requests a day on the Hobby plan, counted across all endpoints
100 requests a minute on the Hobby plan

binding_note: No quota can be reached while registration is closed; if it reopened, 2,000 requests a day would bind long before 100 a minute.

identity_cost.detail: when sign-up was open: a name, email address, business name and country, and an email code to sign in; no credit card for Hobby. The sign-up page is no longer linked.

reliability_note: The home and pricing pages carry Sunset: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 23:59:59 GMT, the archived home page of 2026-08-28 already shows Contact Us in place of the sign-up button, and the sign-up host app.geolocated.io answers HTTP 522 on 2026-11-02.
confidence_note: The pricing, documentation, privacy and archived pages were read on 2026-11-02, and the Sunset header and the HTTP 522 answers were measured. No API request was made: the API server host names are not published on the pages that could be read. A sign-up host that answers again would reopen the verdict.
